caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed Victorian-era dress with no human figure wearing it. The dress has a fitted bodice with buttons down the front, long sleeves that end with lace-trimmed cuffs, and a high patterned collar. The skirt is full and has an overlapped front layer decorated with floral designs, and a lighter, patterned underskirt with scalloped edges towards the bottom, revealing a pleated dark layer beneath. The waist is cinched, and there is a large bow or bustle at the back. The image is in monochrome, primarily using shades of grey and black, showing the details of the fabric and structure. The composition centers the dress vertically on a plain, unadorned light background. There is a signature "Herman Marry" in the lower right corner. No other objects or decorations are present in the drawing.
title: Dress
